translations.web: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
translations.bsb: the sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they took as wives whomever they chose.
translations.kjv: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
